```{r output=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

## Load In
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(AER)
library(dynlm)
library(forecast)
library(readxl)
library(stargazer)
library(scales)
library(quantmod)
library(urca)
library(tseries)
library(strucchange)
library(kableExtra)

####################### Net Worth ###############################
#get data
fiscal_new <- read.csv("posts/Federal Time Series/1010001501-noSymbol.csv")

## Clean Data

fiscal_new_df <- fiscal_new %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -X,
        names_to = "quarter",
        values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    filter(X == "Net worth")


## Subset Data
FedNet <- data.frame(quarter = fiscal_new_df$quarter, NetWorth = fiscal_new_df$value)

# TS format
FedNetTS <- ts(FedNet$NetWorth, start = 1990, end = 2026, frequency = 4)

####################### GDP ###############################

## read in GDP data
gdp <- read.csv("posts/Federal Time Series/3610010401-noSymbol.csv")
## Clean Data

gdpDF <- gdp %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -X,
        names_to = "quarter",
        values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    filter(
        X == "Gross domestic product at market prices",
        quarter != "Q2.2026")

gdpDF_dat <- data.frame(quarter = gdpDF$quarter, GDP = gdpDF$value)

# TS format
GDPTS <- ts(gdpDF_dat$GDP, start = 1990, end = 2026, frequency = 4)


####################### Ratio ###############################

# join data
ratio_data <- left_join(FedNet, gdpDF_dat, by = "quarter")

## calculate GDP-Net Worth Ratio
#ratio = net worth / nominal gdp *100
GDP_Net <- ratio_data %>%
    mutate(ratio = (NetWorth/GDP))
## ratio time series
GDP_Net_TS <- ts(GDP_Net$ratio, 1990, 2026, 4)

```


# Time-Series Analysis of Federal Net Worth
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

```

### Determine Net Worth-GDP Trend and Breaks
```{r output=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: trend

# use Dicky-Fuller test to determine trend
trendTest <- adf.test(GDP_Net_TS)
ur.df(GDP_Net_TS)
# Critical PValue = 0.05. Reject Null if pvalue is above critcal
# H0: deerminstic
# H1: stochastic
trendTest$p.value > 0.05
# failed to reject. trend is Stochastic


## Test for breaks

#breaks in trend
trend_brk <- breakpoints(GDP_Net_TS ~ time(GDP_Net_TS))
summary(trend_brk)
breakdates(trend_brk)
# 4 breaks
```

The Net Worth and GDP Ratio has a stochastic trend and has 4 breaks. We need to make it stationary by taking the first difference and acount for the breaks in the model with dummies

## Make Trend Stationary
```{r output=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
# take first Diff
GDP_Net_Diff <- diff(GDP_Net_TS)

#test for stationarity again
trendTest2 <- adf.test(GDP_Net_Diff)
trendTest2$p.value > 0.05
#We can reject the null now
kpss.test(GDP_Net_Diff)

```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
plot(
    GDP_Net_Diff,
    col = "red",
    lwd = 2,
    ylab = "Value",
    xlab = "Date",
    yaxt = "n",
    main = "Quarterly Canadian GDP-Net Worth Ratio"
)
axis(
    2, at = pretty(range(GDP_Net_Diff), n = 10), 
    labels = percent(pretty(range(GDP_Net_Diff), n = 10))
)
```

Ratio is stationary now

## Choose Models
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
## see general lags
acf(GDP_Net_Diff, main = "ACF")
pacf(GDP_Net_Diff, main = "PACF")
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Use AIC on multiple models
# compute AIC for AR model objects of class 'dynlm'
My_AIC <- function(model) {
  
  ssr <- sum(model$residuals^2)
  t <- length(model$residuals)
  npar <- length(model$coef)
  
  return(
    round(c("p" = npar - 1,
          "AIC" = log(ssr/t) + npar * 2/t,
          "Adj.R2" = summary(model)$adj.r.squared), 4)
  )
}

AIC_Results <- sapply(1:6, function(x) 
        "AR" = My_AIC(dynlm(GDP_Net_Diff ~ L(GDP_Net_Diff, 1:x))))


kable(AIC_Results)
```

AIC yeilds 4 lags may be ideal

### Models
```{r output=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: models
AR_1 <- dynlm(GDP_Net_Diff ~ L(GDP_Net_Diff, 1))
summary(AR_1)
AR_4 <- dynlm(GDP_Net_Diff ~ L(GDP_Net_Diff, 1:4))
summary(AR_4)
#time_index of first diff data
ind <- time(GDP_Net_Diff)
#mark breaks
D1 <- as.numeric(ind > 1996.25)
D2 <- as.numeric(ind > 2001.50)
D3 <- as.numeric(ind > 2008.75)
D4 <- as.numeric(ind > 2020.00)
# run model
AR_dum <- dynlm(GDP_Net_Diff ~ L(GDP_Net_Diff, 1:4) + D1 + D2 + D3 + D4)
summary(AR_dum)
```


```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

stargazer(AR_1, AR_4, AR_dum,
  type = "text",
  title = "AR Models of Net Worth/GDP Ratio Change",
  column.labels = c("AR(1)", "AR(4)", "AR(4) + Breaks"),
  se = list(sqrt(diag(sandwich(AR_1))), sqrt(diag(sandwich(AR_4))), sqrt(diag(sandwich(AR_dum)))),
  omit.stat = c("f", "ser"))
```
